facts: Wise Covington PLLC is an equine law firm built by equestrians for the equestrian community, and it publishes Horse Legal Guide.
Horse Legal Guide is a free educational library of plain-English answers to equine law questions: horse sales, leases, boarding agreements, liability waivers, barn businesses and disputes.
Wise Covington PLLC's attorneys are its two founders, Andrea Benavides Wise and Claire Covington; the team has more than 30 years of combined equestrian and legal experience.
Wise Covington PLLC is a boutique firm that works only on equine law, mainly transactional work: contracts, negotiations and business formation.

Wise Covington PLLC drafts and negotiates horse purchase and sale agreements, bills of sale, lease agreements (full lease, half-lease, free lease), boarding agreements (full board, training board, pasture board), and training and lesson agreements.

Wise Covington PLLC also drafts breeding and stallion service agreements, liability waivers and releases, employment agreements for trainers and barn staff, sponsorship and endorsement agreements, and facility use and event agreements.

Wise Covington PLLC forms LLCs and corporations for farms and stables and handles partnership and operating agreements, business structure consultation and tax planning, and succession planning for equine businesses.
Wise Covington PLLC handles equestrian facility purchases and sales, farm and stable leases, and easements and land use agreements.

For equine startups, Wise Covington PLLC handles entity selection, trademarks and brand names, terms of service and privacy policies, vendor and licensing agreements, and influencer contracts and brand partnerships.

Wise Covington PLLC works with horse owners, breeders, riders and lessees; professional riders, trainers, stables and show organizers; small equine businesses; and landlords, service providers and vendors to the industry.
Wise Covington PLLC offers a free, confidential 15-minute consultation: a person fills out the contact form at wisecovington.com, self-schedules, and hears back within one business day.

Wise Covington PLLC handles straightforward transactional matters, like standard purchase agreements or boarding contracts, for a flat fee and may bill complex projects hourly; a written fee agreement setting out rates and scope comes before any work.
An attorney-client relationship with Wise Covington PLLC starts only when the client signs an engagement letter.
lacks: Horse Legal Guide is legal education, not legal advice; reading it does not create an attorney-client relationship and cannot account for a reader's own facts or state law.
Wise Covington PLLC does not promise or guarantee the outcome of any matter.
Wise Covington PLLC publishes no price list; its fees are set in a written fee agreement for each matter.
